name: Google Ads
alt: Illustration of a sponsored search result, orange target and pointer for Google Ads
description: Reach people actively looking for your service with focused Google search campaigns.
headline: Google Ads management
intro: Google Ads management for small businesses in India. Connect relevant searches with a useful offer, a clear landing page and a measurable enquiry.
overview: A search campaign starts with the reason behind the search. Someone comparing options needs a different message from someone ready to contact a business. I research those needs, organise the campaign around your services, and connect each ad to a relevant next step.
fit: A useful fit for service businesses with an offer people already search for, a test budget and someone ready to follow up on enquiries. We review your service area, competition and website before deciding what to advertise.

includes.heading: Keyword & competitor research
includes.description: Identify useful searches, understand intent and review competing offers. Group related keywords around the services you actually provide.

includes.heading: Campaign & ad-group setup
includes.description: Organise campaigns, locations, schedules and targeting around agreed business goals. Separate services where the message or budget needs to differ.

includes.heading: Ad copy & landing-page review
includes.description: Write clear search ads and check that the destination answers the search. Review the offer, mobile layout and route to a call or enquiry.

includes.heading: Conversion tracking
includes.description: Plan and check meaningful actions such as completed enquiries and calls using the available website, GA4 and Google Tag Manager setup.

includes.heading: Search-term & budget reviews
includes.description: Review actual searches, add relevant negative keywords and examine spend against the actions being measured. Changes follow the evidence available.

includes.heading: Reporting & next steps
includes.description: Explain spend, tracked enquiries, cost per enquiry and the changes made. Discuss lead quality with you so reporting goes beyond click counts.

receive: An agreed campaign plan and service priorities
Campaign structure, keyword groups and ad copy
A tracking checklist and reporting approach
prepare: Bring your website, target locations, priority services and an idea of your monthly ad budget. Access to your advertising and analytics accounts may be needed. If a landing page needs work, we agree that scope separately.
note: Google advertising spend and the management fee are separate. Your offer, competition, landing page and follow-up all affect results; a fixed number of leads or sales is not promised.

faqs.question: How much should I spend on Google Ads?
faqs.answer: The right test budget depends on your services, location, competition and what an enquiry is worth to your business. We review those factors before agreeing a starting plan; there is no universal minimum that works for everyone.

faqs.question: Will I own my Google Ads account?
faqs.answer: Your business should retain ownership of its advertising account. Access, responsibilities and any new account setup are agreed before work begins.

faqs.question: Do I need a landing page?
faqs.answer: The destination needs to match the search and explain your offer clearly. An existing service page may be suitable; if it is confusing or hard to use on mobile, I will recommend improvements or a dedicated landing page.

faqs.question: How do we judge the campaign?
faqs.answer: We review tracked enquiries and cost alongside your feedback on lead quality. Clicks and impressions help explain activity, but they do not prove that a campaign is bringing useful business.
